run_command_check_signal: run a command and return 1 if killed by a signal or 0 otherwise
test_break_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1 and verifying seg-fault behavior
test_break_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_break_on_failure flag by passing 0 or 1 and verifying seg-fault behavior
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
test_break_overrides_throw: test that gtest_break_on_failure overrides gtest_throw_on_failure when both are enabled
